grants.comment: claude-runner coder sessions: read-only estate visibility (resource state + runtime logs) — the agent debugs deployed apps but cannot change Azure outside GitHub Actions.

agent broker (claude-coder's successor platform, Kenneth's ask 2026-07-15): open Arc cluster-connect tunnels to the shared homelab k3s cluster — mirrors the id-claude-coder grant above. The claude-coder entries stay until rg-claude-coder is decommissioned after the parallel-run period.

grants.comment: agent sessions (coder profile): read-only estate visibility (resource state + runtime logs), matching the claude-runner and claude-coder coder profiles. Same identity on both backends (IMDS on ACI, workload-identity federation on the homelab cluster).

agent coder profile: cost visibility, folded in when the cloud-sysadmin profile was retired (2026-07-25). Read-only — 'what is the estate costing' without a second profile. Every Azure CHANGE still goes through Bicep + Actions.

agent local-sysadmin profile: full read-only estate visibility — resource state, runtime logs and cost. Kenneth's ask 2026-08-04: the local-sysadmin profile absorbs the retired cloud-sysadmin role and becomes sysadmin for cloud AND local, so it gets the same read set the coder profile holds (the two grants above). Read-only — every Azure CHANGE still goes through Bicep + Actions. The matching Entra directory read is in graph-grants.json.
